current_boundary_explanation: Foundation stage membership is a fixed Core whitelist, not a suite-specific union.
Core publishes and returns the foundation artifact before task-specific derived stages execute.
The foundation signature must match every consuming profile, so adding optional stages globally would force them into all compatible suites.
Several repeated stages consume or mutate the current AnalysisResult and therefore require explicit cache/projection semantics before sharing.

foundation_layer.description: Общая детерминированная основа для анализа Java-систем: состав репозитория, конфигурация, зависимости, интерфейсы, структурная модель, универсальные Tree-sitter observations, SQL, физическая схема и технические взаимодействия.
foundation_layer.name: Reusable Java repository analysis foundation

known_architecture_tensions.description: Task semantics are split across Runner registry, Core profile and Knowledge Layer task_id routing.
Core profile output_contract/capabilities are declarative and are not the primary Runner/KLC routing contract.
Shared foundation removes universal scans, but identical derived stages may still run in multiple task processes.
Java profile stages control execution, while SQL/spec profile stage lists are descriptive and do not select runtime phases.
Several Core stages assemble cross-fact task/model views that overlap with Knowledge Layer responsibility.

model_summary.artifact_manifest_role: physical contract between Core, Runner and Knowledge Layer
model_summary.core_profile_role: resolved executable recipe of stages, options, declared capabilities and output policy
model_summary.foundation_role: universal reusable repository evidence snapshot shared by suite task processes
model_summary.pipeline_profile_role: user-facing application workflow that chooses suite/direct profile and downstream report behavior
model_summary.stage_role: profile-declared operation; Java stages are runtime-controlled while SQL/spec stage lists are currently descriptive labels
model_summary.suite_role: ordered orchestration of task runs with one reusable foundation by default
model_summary.task_role: named isolated profile run plus retry/output/provenance and current Knowledge Layer routing key

profile_layer.description: Общая evidence foundation плюс persistence origin resolution на явно заданной глубине, effective data-model materialization и детерминированная conceptual model. Не строит repository-wide field-flow и не извлекает полные declared-value sets.
profile_layer.name: Complete system data-model evidence

profile_layer.description: Lightweight repository profile for large Bitbucket portfolio discovery. It observes structural model signals, schema-bearing files and model tooling, then publishes a ranked candidate profile. It does not build a data model, persistence lineage, interaction topology or a multi-repository workspace.
profile_layer.name: Data model candidate discovery

profile_layer.description: Proof-oriented ingress, call, field-flow and traceability evidence. This profile intentionally excludes persistence origin resolution so repository-scale field-flow evidence is materialized in an isolated process with predictable memory and syntax-runtime lifecycle.
profile_layer.name: System boundary and field-flow evidence

profile_layer.description: Lightweight facts-only profile for intersystem HTTP attribute lineage. It reuses the repository foundation and adds only direct data-flow and field-flow evidence required by Knowledge Layer boundary contracts, wire reconstruction, transport edges and bounded attribute-path resolution. Persistence, conceptual data model, declared-value expansion and execution-context traceability are intentionally excluded.
profile_layer.name: Lightweight intersystem attribute lineage evidence

profile_layer.description: Source-to-storage and storage-to-access origin resolution at explicitly configured persistence depth in an isolated analysis process. It excludes repository-wide field-flow materialization so the persistence resolver does not compete with a second large evidence graph.
profile_layer.name: System persistence lineage evidence

profile_layer.description: Minimal repository profile for large Bitbucket portfolio topology. It extracts configuration, declared dependencies, OpenAPI contracts, Java structural interfaces and direct HTTP/configuration boundary composition. Source observation stores, SQL, physical schema, persistence, value-flow and traceability are intentionally excluded.
profile_layer.name: Portfolio topology evidence

profile_layer.description: Модель данных и явно объявленные наборы значений для последующей семантической NSI/reference-data интерпретации. Анализатор не классифицирует НСИ.
profile_layer.name: System reference-data evidence

profile_layer.description: Системные границы, интерфейсы, зависимости, наблюдаемое использование хранилищ, scenario traceability и полные storage summaries и bounded summaries явно заданных наборов значений. Complete effective/conceptual data model intentionally runs in the companion `repository-system-data-model` process so large object graphs do not accumulate in one interpreter.
profile_layer.name: System description evidence

architecture_findings.finding: Java profile stages are runtime-controlled, but dependency order and data passing are encoded in pipeline.py rather than stage contracts.
SQL profile pipeline.stages are descriptive labels; run_sql_analysis executes a fixed analyzer and does not branch on the profile stage list.
Spec profile pipeline.stages are descriptive labels; run_spec_analysis executes a fixed normalization pipeline and only reads profile metadata.
Several Java stages consume the whole accumulated AnalysisResult, preventing independent caching and making results depend on profile execution history.
System-description views, reference-data fact-base and conceptual-model assembly combine already extracted facts and should be evaluated for KLC ownership.
The catalog can now show observed Java requires/provides and mutation behavior, but Core profiles still do not declare or validate those contracts.
db_schema_scan extracts physical declarations and also launches SQL table observations, mixing base and derived evidence in one stage.

architecture_findings.finding: The observed requires/provides relations are encoded in pipeline.py and scanner signatures; profiles do not declare them.
